name: Shrimp Creole
author: Mitchell Marquez on based.cooking

ingredients.item: 2 cups of Celery, diced (try to get one with lots of green leaves)
1/4 cup of olive or cooking oil
1 cup Heinz chili sauce (it looks like ketchup but is not)
3x 14.5 oz cans of diced tomato - optionally blend one

steps: Add shrimp and cook for 5 minutes
[optional] Best if cooked a day ahead and reheated.

culture.text: Shrimp creole is a dish of Louisiana Creole origin, consisting of cooked shrimp in a mixture of whole or diced tomatoes, the "holy trinity" of onion, celery and bell pepper, spiced with hot pepper sauce or cayenne-based seasoning, and served over steamed or boiled white rice. The shrimp may be cooked in the mixture or cooked separately and added at the end. Other "creole" dishes may be made by substituting some other meat or seafood for the shrimp, or omitting the meat entirely.
